verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents Loop, a built-in AI agent that users can ask to investigate logs in natural language and to build scorers, datasets and dashboards. Patterns extends this by running Loop on a schedule to find recurring problems and suggest fixes, which is direct delegation of work to an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on Loop's task scope, approval and controls, and independent or hands-on confirmation that delegated tasks work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Loop is Braintrust’s AI agent. It understands your data structure, so you can investigate your logs through natural language instead of writing queries.
Ask Braintrust’s AI agent to investigate your data and build scorers, datasets, and dashboards
Build datasets from production logs, user feedback, manual curation, or generate them with Loop.

Patterns puts Loop to work on your trace backlog on a schedule. It searches for recurring problems and trends that no scorer already measures, then records each one with the traces that support it and a suggested fix.
